verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents headless APIs and a Web SDK for building your own ramps: session creation, quotes, payment-method listing and deletion, connection management, credential retrieval, and OpenAPI-based client codegen. However, core steps still run through MoonPay-hosted UI frames rather than pure API calls, including PCI card capture, the self-driving verification challenge frame, the auth/OTP frame and buy/payment-button frames. Off-ramp selling is described only as a widget flow with MFA login. Missing for 10: pure API (frameless) execution of auth, KYC/challenge and card entry; evidenced API parity for off-ramp and swap flows; a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probes of standard paths returned 404); independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
